CYD Crypto Price Display

Web flasher for ESP32-2432S028 (CYD) — 320x240 ST7789 + XPT2046 touch

USB Access Required: This flasher uses Web Serial API and requires the ESP32 to be connected to this computer's USB port. It will not work from inside the Umbrel container.

Manual Flash (Alternative)

If the web flasher doesn't work, flash from terminal:

esptool.py --chip esp32 --port /dev/ttyUSB0 --baud 921600 \
  write_flash 0x1000 bootloader.bin 0x8000 partitions.bin 0x10000 cyd-crypto-ticker_firmware.bin

Features

  • Crypto prices via CoinGecko (configurable, up to 10 coins)
  • Weather via Open-Meteo (ZIP code geocoding)
  • Touch: tap=refresh, triple-tap=toggle weather, long-press=rotate display
  • Hold screen on boot to WiFi config portal (AP: CYD-Ticker-Setup)
  • Web config at http:///config after WiFi setup
